author: Zhang, Defen
summary: While our material lives are becoming increasingly abundant, more and more people are struggling with depression and anxiety. That’s because we’ve gone off course—constantly competing, comparing, and grasping in the external world, while few take the time to focus on inner fulfillment and true joy. I hope that the classic book “Meeting the Unknown Self” will continue to awaken more people, reminding them that the real path to happiness and well-being lies within—in self-exploration, in pleasing oneself rather than trying to please others. Those who are willing to listen, reflect, and realign themselves in time will find themselves growing steadily in happiness and peace. But for those who remain fixated on chasing external rewards and achievements, life’s suffering will only become more intense and overwhelming. When we are willing to surrender and humbly release our pain, embracing the flow of life as it is, there is a sense of freedom and liberation that I hope more people will come to experience

title: 水曜旮旯 | Shui yao ga la = Circus Of Life
author: Ying, Zi Li
summary:
Ying Zi's rough brushstrokes, strong colors with a no-holds-barred emotional expression, and irregular compositions easily catch the reader's eye. 
 
Her painting style may seem reckless, but it contains themes of order in chaos, of nostalgic things, of nostalgic characters, of embracing the everyday, which is fascinating and captivating. 
 
Paired with a concise and to-the-point narration, it is not only interesting to see the artist's life, but also to remember the various similar people and things that have been around her. While flipping through Ying Zi's stories, one is able to savor small moments in one's own life that have been sealed away for years.
